app.name: Screen Time
login.title: Sign in
login.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few random words make a good password.
login.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
children.title: Children
children.empty: No children yet. Add a child to set their daily screen time.
today.noDevices: No devices yet. Pair one on the Devices tab.
today.extraHelp: Adds to today's daily limit only. Tomorrow is back to normal.
rules.name: Name
rules.dailyTotalHelp: All apps and websites together, on all of this child's devices. Exempt apps don't count.
rules.appsHelp: A limited app counts toward its own limit and the daily screen time. An exempt app is never blocked and never counts.
rules.noRules: No app rules. Every app counts toward the daily screen time.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? All their devices and usage history are removed. This can't be undone.
offline.title: Offline allowance
offline.summary: If a device loses internet, it can keep using up to {minutes} of today's time before it locks. That time is set aside for that device, so {name} can never go over the daily limit by going offline.
offline.summaryZero: If a device loses internet, it locks straight away (exempt apps keep working). This is the strictest setting.
offline.how1: Every device checks in with the server every few seconds. While it's online, a small amount of today's remaining time is set aside for it, just in case it goes offline.
offline.how2: Time set aside for one device can't be used on the others, so the total across all devices never goes over the daily limit.
offline.example: The daily limit is 2 hours, and the child has a phone and a PC. The phone loses its connection with 10 minutes set aside, so the PC now has 10 minutes less to use. The phone uses 6 minutes while offline. When it's back online, the 4 minutes it didn't use go back to the shared time.
offline.tradeoffHigh: Higher: fewer interruptions on patchy Wi-Fi or mobile data, but that time can't be used on other devices while it's set aside.
offline.tradeoffLow: Lower, or 0: strictest, but the device locks whenever it loses its connection.
offline.range: 0–60 minutes. You can also set a different value for a single device on the Devices tab.
devices.title: Devices
devices.pairHelp: Create a code, then enter it in the Screen Time app on {name}'s device. The code works once and expires after 10 minutes.
devices.allowanceHelp: Overrides the child's offline allowance for this device only. Applies the next time the device checks in, usually within 15 seconds.
devices.unpairConfirm: Unpair {device}? It stops being able to connect. Its usage today still counts.
apps.title: Apps
apps.help: Rules are set per app. Each app is recognised on every device by its identifiers: program names on computers, app IDs on phones, and websites.
apps.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its rules are removed, and its usage counts as other apps from now on.
apps.unassignedHelp: Programs and websites seen on your children's devices in the last 7 days that don't belong to an app. They still count toward the daily screen time. Assign one to an app so its rules apply.
apps.unassignedLine: {minutes} in the last 7 days · last seen {date}
